methodology.bg: Национално представително проучване на Алфа Рисърч по поръчка на в. „Дневник“. Извадка, стратифицирана по тип населено място; респондентите са подбрани по квота по пол, възраст и образование.
methodology.en: Alpha Research nationally representative survey commissioned by Dnevnik. Sample stratified by settlement type; respondents selected by quota on sex, age and education.

residual.notes: Final pre-election wave for 12 May 2013, commissioned by Dnevnik. Shares are AR's ROUNDED expected share of valid votes ("около"), among firm decided voters — not raw attitudes. ДПС excludes votes from Turkey. Not stored: ДБГ 2.5% (base = ALL voters, not valid votes) and ДСБ/НФСБ/СДС/РЗС/ВМРО "между 2 и 2.7%" (range, no per-party figure). Hand-transcribed 2026-10-05 from the agency .doc attachment (Data-Pre election-study.doc); the extractor read nothing from it.
